name: Stack Sentinel
tagline: Pings you the moment a provider your build depends on admits a problem
description: Keeps a tab on the vendor-run health dashboards behind the pieces of a modern stack: model APIs, code hosting, edge and deploy platforms. Each check is compared against the previous one by a small local script, so a calm day costs almost nothing to watch, and you hear from it only when a state genuinely flips.
author: sat0xshi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
